items.title: Phil Woods — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I met Jill, and fell in love with Jill, my present wife, Jill Goodwin

ctx.x: Yeah, so I remember being in uh, when I was in L.A., uh a local the local, Donte’s, the local jazz

club wanted me, you know. They heard that I was in town so I gave them a pretty stiff price. I mean, I was used to five years in Europe, you know, I wasn’t going to work for scale. And I remember the club owner saying, “Stay here long enough, we’ll get you to for scale,” and I said, “I’m out of here,” you know. And by that point my marriage to Chan was kind of on the rocks, and I met Jill, and fell in love with Jill, my present wife, Jill Goodwin, who happens to be my, the sister of my drummer, Bill Goodwin.
